verdict.rationale: Exa has a dedicated rate-limits documentation page stating that its API endpoints have default rate limits (exa-docs-16), and a self-serve pricing page offering sign-up credits with no payment method required (exa-docs-34). The evidence does not show the actual limit values, any concurrency caps, or how a developer raises limits without contacting sales. Missing for 10: specific per-endpoint rate-limit numbers, documented concurrency caps, an explicit self-serve upgrade path for higher limits, independent corroboration.
